scripts/blender/build_skeleton.py.reason: Python bone build (tooth decimation weight); M15 moves build tables into build.json (SPEC-platform §9.1).

scripts/blender/build_soft_tissue.py.reason: Python soft-tissue build (layer list, budgets, minimum triangles, AO spread); M15's build.json.

scripts/blender/pipeline_lib.py.reason: Shared Blender pipeline (bone material name, bounds-check label); M15's build.json.

scripts/content/patch-check.ts.reason: Patch agreement report for muscles and parts; moves with softRoles.ts to M12's edges.

scripts/lib/soft-tree-data.ts.reason: Builds the ligament and cartilage tree data; M12's TreeSpec.

scripts/mapping/classify_soft_tissue.py.reason: M6 soft-tissue classifier (layer and kind per source object); M15's per-system mapping.

scripts/mapping/generate_ids.py.reason: Bone and tooth ID generator; M15's per-system mapping.

scripts/mapping/generate_soft_ids.py.reason: Soft-tissue ID generator (layers, kinds); M15's per-system mapping.

scripts/perf-load.ts.reason: Times turning on the largest layer (the muscles), named as the result field; M14's real-device and perf runs choose the layer from the registry (its budgets).

src/content/announce.ts.reason: Wording for muscles (attachments, functional group, antagonist counts) and the part → muscle count fallback; M12 re-expresses tiers and antagonists as edges with their own wording.

src/content/groups.ts.reason: Bone tree's tooth-type groups and the muscle synonym sets' layer; M12 builds the trees from TreeSpec.

src/content/names.ts.reason: Bone display names (teeth have no side suffix); M12 moves display names onto the panel descriptor.

src/content/panel.ts.reason: The bone panel model (tooth type line, names); M12 puts the bones on the shared panel.

src/content/placeholder.ts.reason: The bone placeholder panel (tooth badges and names); M12's shared panel.

src/content/schema.ts.reason: The bone front-matter schema (bone/tooth kinds); M12 moves the bones onto the content halves' per-kind schemas.

src/content/softPanel.ts.reason: The soft panel's per-kind sections, labels and tier wording; M12's PanelSpec.

src/content/softTree.ts.reason: The soft sidebar roots and their per-layer builders; M12's TreeSpec.

src/content/softValidate.ts.reason: Per-kind validation rules (muscle hierarchy, ligament joints); M12 moves them onto the content halves.

src/content/validate.ts.reason: Bone validation (bone and tooth counts, muscle lists on bones); M12 with the bone content half.

src/ui/InfoPanel.tsx.reason: Per-kind panel rendering (muscle sections, ligament/cartilage joint lines, tooth); M12's PanelSpec.
